{{Quote|We've been translating the Rakata inscriptions. Most are indecipherable, but a few refer to a prisoner called "the Infernal One." We've seen the title before, in the Dead Corals of Rugosa and the Ziost Abyss. We thought it a myth&mdash;the Rakata warlord who bled and enslaved a thousand planets.|[[Threnoldt]]|audio=WhatTheRakatansCalledBillBrasky-TOR.flac|<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dead Corals''' was a region on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], the coral [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The title, "[[Soa|the Infernal One]]" was inscribed in the Dead Corals.<ref name="SWTOR" />
